query: SELECT runner.id, name, COUNT(*) OVER() AS "total_count!" FROM runner INNER JOIN RESOURCES_WITH_PERMISSION_FOR_LOGIN_ID($2, $3) AS resource ON runner.id = resource.id WHERE workspace_id = $1 AND runner.deleted IS NULL AND ($4::TEXT IS NULL OR name ILIKE '%' || $4 || '%') ORDER BY resource.created DESC LIMIT $5 OFFSET $6;
